How the forecast develops through 2030

Dot = median · line = P05–P95 uncertainty from 500 simulations
How to read this: The map is the most-likely 2026 state for each building, not a certainty. Later years are shown only as aggregate uncertainty ranges because the exported forecast does not assign a 2028 or 2030 state to each footprint. This is a baseline projection with no interventions, not a causal policy claim.
Model: empirical Markov, two-year transitions · Scenario: business as usual · Source: Beirut Built Environment Database, Beirut Urban Lab (AUB) · ODbL
